Author: Minescence
Name: Fur Renderer
Description: Grows hundreds of thousands of skinned hair strands on any chosen item or minion based on their texture or material, and draws them with the GPU. Follows the dye and the scene's light. Only you see it.
Changelog: Fixed the dark outline of fur around a tail or anything else lying on a fur item. New "Smooth shadows" setting: small shadows on the model no longer show as dark blotches in the fur. New "Strand cap" setting: very big items grow fewer, wider strands instead of using gigabytes of video memory. No more one-second freeze when the plugin loads.
